post.caption:
Tuesday, 9am. You told a client you would get back to them last Thursday.
Nobody forgot on purpose. There was just no system holding the follow-ups.
Here are five open source tools that do the holding. EspoCRM shows who needs a nudge. Easy!Appointments lets clients book a slot. listmonk emails everyone at once. n8n runs the repeat steps. Invoice Ninja handles quotes and invoices.
You can run all five yourself. Check each licence before using one for clients.
Comment "FOLLOWUP" and I will send you the links.
Save this for the next time a client goes quiet.
